description: Kollmorgen (Danaher Motion) SERVOSTAR 600 family ASCII parameter dictionary for the parameters present in the AMC dumps (firmware V7.20). Descriptions are condensed from the SERVOSTAR 600 ASCII object reference; entries marked confidence 'medium' or 'low' should be verified against the official 'SERVOSTAR 600 ASCII Command Reference' before changing values. Values are written with the drive's units: current in A, speed in rpm, time in ms, position in increments of 2^20 per revolution (PRBASE 20) unless PGEARI/PGEARO scaling applies.

ACC.desc: Acceleration ramp for the velocity/position set-point (ms to reach VLIM, or units per ACCUNIT)

ACCR.desc: Acceleration ramp for homing / reference traverse

ACCUNIT.desc: Unit selection for acceleration values (0 = ms)

ACTFAULT.desc: Behaviour on fault: 1 = active braking (controlled stop) on error, 0 = disable immediately

ADDR.desc: Station (CAN / serial) address of the drive, read-only in the dump (;ADDR). X=8, Y1=7, Y2=6, Z=5, A=18, B=17

AENA.desc: Auto-enable after power-up (0 = wait for software enable)

ALIAS.desc: Drive name shown in the software (X, Y1, Y2, Z, A1, B1)

AN10TX / AN11NR / AN11RANGE.desc: Analogue input 1 / position-via-analogue options (not used, defaults)

AN1TRIG / AN2TRIG.desc: Trigger thresholds (mV) for analogue inputs 1/2 used as digital triggers

ANOUT1 / ANOUT2.desc: Function of analogue monitor outputs 1/2 on X3 (1 = actual speed, 2 = actual current)

AUTOHOME.desc: Start homing automatically after enable (0 = off)

AVZ1.desc: Smoothing/filter time constant of the analogue set-point input (ms)

BOOT.desc: Boot/setup flag (1 on X: parameter set flagged as valid after setup)

BQDC / BQDR / BQFC / BQFR / BQMODE.desc: Bi-quad (notch / band-stop) filter of the current set-point: centre frequency, damping, mode (1 = enabled)

CBAUD.desc: CAN bus baud rate in kbit/s (1000 = 1 Mbit/s)

CPHASE.desc: Commutation phase / motor phase sequence correction

DAOFFSET1 / DAOFFSET2.desc: D/A converter offsets of the monitor outputs (read-only)

DECDIS.desc: Deceleration ramp used when the drive is disabled by software / enable removed (ms). X/Y 10 ms, Z/A/B 300 ms

DECSTOP.desc: Emergency / STOP ramp (ms) used on limit switch, STOP command or fault with ACTFAULT 1

DENA.desc: Disable enable-timeout monitoring / direct enable behaviour

DIR.desc: Direction of rotation: 1 = positive set-point turns the motor clockwise, 0 = counter-clockwise (X=1, Y1/Y2=0, Z=0, A/B=1)

DNBAUD / DNMACID.desc: DeviceNet baud rate and MAC id (not used)

DREF.desc: Direction of reference search / mode detail

EMRGTO.desc: Emergency time-out (ms) after which the drive is disabled when a controlled stop does not finish

ENCIN.desc: Resolution (lines x4) of the external encoder input at X5 used as master for electronic gearing (X: 4096, A/B: 8192)

ENCLINES.desc: Lines per revolution of the encoder emulation output (ROD) at X5, or of the motor encoder with FBTYPE 12 (X/Y 512, Z 1000, A/B 2000)

ENCMODE.desc: Encoder emulation output mode (1 = ROD A/B incremental output)

ENCOUT.desc: Encoder emulation output resolution (lines) when configured as output

ENCZERO.desc: Offset of the emulated zero pulse / encoder zero position (A/B: 23)

ENGAGE.desc: Engage (couple to master) for electronic gearing (0 = not engaged at power-up)

ERND.desc: Rounding / modulo value of the position (A/B/Z: 10239999 = modulo axis range, X/Y: max = linear)

EXTLATCH / EXTMUL / EXTPOS / EXTWD.desc: External position / encoder input options: latch, multiplier, external position mode, watchdog (ms)

FBTYPE.desc: Motor feedback type: 0 = resolver (X, Y1, Y2, Z), 12 = incremental encoder with Hall signals at X5 (A1/B1 FHA-14C actuators). Check the official table before changing.

FILTMODE.desc: Current controller / set-point filter mode (X 2, Z 1)

FLUXM.desc: Flux / magnetising value for field weakening (asynchronous motors) or a constant

GEARI.desc: Electronic gearing ratio numerator (input increments) - X/Y 8192, A/B 4000

GEARO.desc: Electronic gearing ratio denominator (output increments) - X/Y 8192, A/B 4096

GEARMODE.desc: Source of the master signal for electronic gearing / external encoder (X/Y/Z: 6, A/B: 3). Value meaning depends on the firmware table (ROD/SSI/pulse-direction at X5 or X1).

GF.desc: Feed-forward / filter gain of the velocity loop (%)

GP.desc: Position controller proportional gain (Kv). X 0.01, Y1/Y2 0.15, Z/A/B 0.05

GPFBT / GPFFT / GPFFV.desc: Position loop feedback / feed-forward filter time constants and velocity feed-forward factor

GVT2.desc: Velocity controller second (PT2) filter time constant (ms)

GVTN.desc: Velocity controller integral action time (ms): X/Y 6, Z 10, A/B 15

I2TLIM.desc: I2t warning threshold in % of ICONT

ICONT.desc: Rated (continuous) current limit of the drive for this motor (A): X/Y 3, Z 1.42, A/B 1.06

IN1MODE .. IN4MODE.desc: Function of digital inputs 1-4 on X3: 0 = off, 1 = reset, 2 = PSTOP, 3 = NSTOP, 12 = reference (homing) switch; values 4/5 on X/Y are limit-switch variants (verify in the ASCII reference). Z: IN1 12, IN3 2, IN4 3; X/Y: IN3 4, IN4 5; A/B: none (limits handled by the control).

IN1TRIG .. IN4TRIG.desc: Auxiliary trigger value for the corresponding digital input function

INHCMD / INHCMDX / INLCMD / INLCMDX.desc: Commands executed on input high/low transitions (ECHO = none)

INTERPOL.desc: Interpolation mode for cyclic position set-points (0 = off)

IO11A / IO11IN.desc: Configuration of the I/O extension / input 11 (not used)

IPEAK.desc: Peak current limit of the drive (A): X/Y 6, Z 5.7, A/B 3.2

IPEAKN.desc: Peak current limit in negative direction (A)

ISCALE1 / ISCALE2.desc: Scaling of analogue inputs when used as current set-point (A per 10 V)

MAXTEMPM.desc: Motor temperature sensor threshold (resistance in kOhm for PTC/KTY)

MBRAKE.desc: Motor holding brake present (1 = yes: Z axis AKM24C-NBB)

MDRV.desc: Motor data source / motor database flag

MICONT.desc: Motor rated current (A) from the motor data

MNAME.desc: Motor name in the motor database (HPG20A21H, AKM24C, NN = user-defined motor data for the FHA-14C)

MPHASE.desc: Motor phase / commutation offset (electrical degrees or table index)

MPOLES.desc: Number of motor poles (12 for HPG/FHA 6 pole-pairs, 8 for AKM24C)

MSG.desc: Message output enable on the serial interface

MSPEED.desc: Motor maximum speed from motor data (rpm): HPG 4800, AKM24C 5500, FHA 6000

MTYPE.desc: Motor type: 1 = synchronous (resolver), 2 = synchronous with encoder/other feedback (A/B), 3 = asynchronous

MVR.desc: Motor voltage rating / rated speed detail

NONBTB.desc: Behaviour of the BTB/RTO ready relay (0 = standard)

NREF.desc: Reference traverse type detail / home switch polarity

O1MODE / O2MODE.desc: Function of digital outputs DOUT1 / DOUT2 on X3 (0 = off)

O1TRIG / O2TRIG.desc: Trigger values for the output functions

OPMODE.desc: Operating mode: 0 digital velocity, 1 analogue velocity, 2 digital torque, 3 analogue torque, 4 electronic gearing, 5 trajectory (position), 8 position / motion tasks (all drives here: 8)

OVRIDE.desc: Override of the motion task velocity in %

P1 .. P16.desc: User positions / general purpose position registers

PBALMAX.desc: Maximum continuous regen (ballast) power (W) - 40 W internal

PBALRES.desc: Regen (ballast) resistor: 0 = internal, 1 = external (Z axis uses an external resistor)

PGEARI.desc: Position scaling numerator: user position units per PGEARO increments (X 10000, A/B 8000)

PGEARO.desc: Position scaling denominator (1048576 = 2^20 increments per revolution)

PRBASE.desc: Position resolution base: 20 = 2^20 increments per revolution

PTBASE.desc: Time base multiplier for the position loop (12)

PTMIN.desc: Minimum motion task time / position loop time (X 10, A/B 1)

PVMAX.desc: Maximum velocity for position mode / motion tasks in user units (X 10000, Z 500008, A/B 800000)

PVMAXN.desc: Maximum negative velocity in position mode

RDP / RDPBIAS / RDPBIAS2 / RDPCLAMP / RD.desc: Redundant / dual-loop (secondary feedback) position controller parameters (not used)

REFIP.desc: Homing: in-position behaviour / reference input selection (3)

REFMODE.desc: Reference traverse mode (0 = via reference switch)

SRND.desc: Rounding / start value of the modulo range

STOPMODE.desc: Stop behaviour: 1 = ramp with DECSTOP then disable

SWE0 .. SWE5N.desc: Software limit switch / position event thresholds (all 0 = off)

SYNCSRC.desc: Synchronisation source for the fieldbus (3 = CAN sync)

TBRAKE.desc: Brake engage delay time (ms) after disable

TRUN.desc: Operating hours counter of the drive (read-only)

UVLTMODE.desc: Under-voltage monitoring mode (1 = warning/fault when DC bus below VBUSMIN)

VBUSBAL.desc: DC bus balancing / 400 V class flag (1 on the 600 V drives X/Y/Z, 0 on the 230 V supplied A/B drives)

VBUSMIN.desc: Minimum DC bus voltage (V) before under-voltage reaction

VCOMM.desc: Speed (rpm) at which commutation / voltage limit applies (motor data)

VEL0.desc: Reference traverse (homing) speed in user units or % (5)

VLIM.desc: Application speed limit (rpm): X/Y 4800, Z 3000, A/B 6000

VMIX / VMUL.desc: Velocity mixing / multiplier options for gearing

VSCALE1 / VSCALE2.desc: Scaling of analogue inputs as speed set-point (rpm per 10 V)

WSAMPL / WSTIME.desc: Wake & shake commutation finding amplitude / time (0 = not used, resolver and Hall feedback do not need it)

ORDER.desc: Motion task definition lines: ORDER n position velocity acc dec ... (tasks 1-3 and 192-194 are present in every drive; 192+ are the ROM/system copies used by the homing and jog functions)

key_differences_between_axes.X vs Y1/Y2: identical except ALIAS, DIR (Y = 0) and GP (Y = 0.15 vs X 0.01)
key_differences_between_axes.X vs Z: AKM24C motor data (MNAME, MPOLES 8, L 43.8 mH, MKT 0.5, MICONT 1.42, MIPEAK 5.7, MSPEED 5500), VLIM 3000, ENCLINES 1000, MBRAKE 1, PBALRES 1 (external regen resistor), IN1MODE 12 / IN3MODE 2 / IN4MODE 3, GV 2, GVTN 10, GPV 5, FILTMODE 1, DECDIS/DECSTOP 300, PVMAX 500008, ERND 10239999
key_differences_between_axes.X vs A/B: FBTYPE 12 encoder+Hall, MNAME NN, MSPEED 6000, VLIM 6000, MICONT 1.06, MIPEAK 3.2, ICONT 1.06, IPEAK 3.2, ENCLINES 2000, ENCIN 8192, ENCZERO 23, GEARI 4000 / GEARO 4096, GEARMODE 3, PGEARI 8000, PVMAX 800000, GVTN 15, KC 1, KTN 0.6, ISCALE 9, DECDIS/DECSTOP 300, VBUSBAL 0, BOOT 0, I2TLIM 100, ERND 10239999
key_differences_between_axes.A vs B: only ALIAS and the read-only header (serial number, ADDR, TRUN)
